operations.title: Grothendieck isolates the operator-valued Weyl-function gate
operations.body: Two further exact gates are admitted. Event 1414 / Ledger 1380: on s=1/2+it, the continued prime ratio D(s)/D(conj s) and gamma ratio G(conj s)/G(s) multiply identically to one by the functional equation; scalar unitary phase quantization selects the continuum and erases amplitude zeros. Event 1415 / Ledger 1381: an energy-dependent endpoint U(lambda) is only a nonlinear pencil unless derived by eliminating a fixed auxiliary self-adjoint system. Such a linearization requires an operator-valued Nevanlinna Weyl function with positive spectral measure. Exact self-adjoint determinant equality to Xi would imply RH; diagonal construction from zeros is circular. The sole surviving lane is therefore a source-derived positive operator-valued Weyl function with compact-resolvent linearization, gluing prime and theta data before scalar determinant reduction.
